notes: Arroyo uses Postgres for pipeline state; wire it to the same Postgres instance as other services.
AWS_ENDPOINT_URL / AWS_ENDPOINT point to MinIO's internal Railway hostname.
KAFKA_BROKERS is consumed by arroyo-pipeline-deployer (not Arroyo itself) to substitute into SQL files.
arroyo-pipeline-deployer runs as a separate one-shot service — see arroyo-deployer.json.
